data.narrative:
Primoco UAV is a publicly listed defense and security company founded by Ladislav Semetkovský. The company has raised €44M+ and maintains an active orderbook. The valuation exercise draws from a universe of 21 Defense & Security sector peers, comprising 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Evolv Technology, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Peer-median methodology is inapplicable due to insufficient narrow-stage comparable density. Only one same-stage peer exists within Defense & Security, falling short of the three-datapoint minimum required for reliable triangulation. Adjacent-stage and similar-valuation-tier filtering yielded no additional matches. An all-sector median approach would introduce excessive sectoral heterogeneity and risk material misstatement.

The analysis cannot support a quantified valuation range at this time. Resolving valuation requires either: (1) expansion of the peer set to include broader-tier Defense & Security firms at acceptable methodological cost, or (2) application of DCF or revenue-multiple approaches using target-specific financial data not provided here. The primary uncertainty is sparse public market comparables in the specialized defense UAV subsector, which limits external benchmarking. Materiality drivers include orderbook conversion rates, gross margin profile, and R&D scaling efficiency relative to revenue growth.
